technical-summary: RX 6900 XT tail quad rows kernel (lane_moe_rows_w4_quaddpp) decodes W4NL in registers instead of an LDS table and folds its quad reduction into v_add_f32_dpp. gfx1030: ds_read 108->76, ~133 fewer instructions, VGPR 115->116, no scratch. Output hashes identical on 40 captured tail requests; quad GEMM -9%; cold 27k TTFT median -1.8% (95% CI -3.6%..-0.6%); doc prefill and decode at parity. XTX helpers use the grouped GEMM and are unaffected.
user-summary-candidate: Long prompts start answering about 2% sooner on the four-GPU layout because the tail GPU's expert kernel does less work per step; output is unchanged.
